{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any QA orders have converted == 1
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]
len(qa_converted)"}
